Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Pranayam. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRANAYAM
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Pranayam helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PRANAYAM
Study Pranayam like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher

What this means
In this part you learn to practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Pranayam” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher. Write or say your answer clearly.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate pranayam as a way  Learners to be engaged in group of coping with emotions activity to practice pranayam. 5.2 Asanas (Body.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate pranayam as a way  Learners to be engaged in group of coping with emotions activity to practice pranayam. 5.2 Asanas (Body. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Pranayam is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Pranayam” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Pranayam in your own words. (skill: appreciate pranayam as a way  Learners to be engaged in group of coping with emotions activity to practice pranayam. 5.2 Asanas (Body)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Pranayam to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate pranayam as a way  Learners to be engaged in group of coping with emotions activity to practice pranayam. 5.2 Asanas (Body.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Pranayam from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Pranayam: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Pranayam?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are asanas?
2. Why do you exercise?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Pranayam means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: practice exercises for physical through audio-visual aids /charts/ development Resource person/teacher.
5. Be able to: appreciate pranayam as a way  Learners to be engaged in group of coping with emotions activity to practice pranayam. 5.2 Asanas (Body.
